title: Register a device sheet search folder
summary: Adds, lists and removes the folders Altium Designer searches for device sheets through the device sheet manager, and flushes the IntegratedLibrary server options after each change.
phrasings: add a folder to the device sheet search paths
save server options to user settings

commands.name: AddDeviceSheetPath
commands.description: Add a folder to the device sheet folders and flush the IntegratedLibrary server options
commands.params: Path=<folder> (required on the pipe; the menu opens ChooseDeviceFolder)|Recursive (flag, search subfolders)

commands.name: ListDeviceSheetPaths
commands.description: List the device sheet folders with their subfolder flag

commands.name: RemoveDeviceSheetPath
commands.description: Remove a folder from the device sheet folders and flush the IntegratedLibrary server options
